SINGLE_HYPOTHESIS: In ProcessWideFp32CachedRows, replace the RMS finalize [Duplicate + Sqrt + scalar reciprocal] with a vector-pipe Rsqrt: compute meanSquare as one-element Muls+Adds on the ReduceSum result, apply Rsqrt, and pull invRms with a single GetValue (no scalar divide). Per row this removes one scalar division and one V/S round trip. The affine application, store placement, dispatch conditions, tile constants, and all non-CachedRows paths are unchanged.
WHY_NOT_DUPLICATE: R31A V021 moved the MTE3-to-V wait in the CachedRows output pass (sync placement, not denominator primitive). V022 changed the batch-entry dispatch predicate. V020 was a pass-1 dual-slot MTE2/V prefetch. None touches the RMS denominator computation. V006 folded mean-eps-sqrt on the narrow-row path. The one-element vector Muls+Adds pattern is R31A's own (ProcessNarrowSingleTile, submission.asc:1174-1176, comment 'One-element mean/sqrt kept in the vector pipe; one GetValue'); V023 brings that established pattern to CachedRows and swaps the Sqrt+scalar-reciprocal tail for Rsqrt. Cross-route: EPILOGUE-ARITH owns the epilogue arithmetic chain (Mul+Add fusion in the output affine) and is untouched; STORE-EPILOGUE-X owns store merging and is untouched; SHAPE-TILING owns tile policy and is untouched. R31B / DTYPE-SPECIAL-X / MIX-A have no Rsqrt denominator change in the R31A CachedRows path. VECTOR-MATH-X (MAIN-2, parent FROZEN_R31B_V011) owns the denominator pipeline broadly; this is a minimal primitive swap confined to one R31A function on the R31A V016 parent, not a denominator pipeline redesign. Full analysis in 研究/R31A/next-hypotheses.md H1 section.
